event_summary: In a shallow bowl, four colored raised mounds sit in liquid while surrounding colored regions slowly broaden and blur.
raw_event_description: The video shows a shallow beige bowl containing a shallow pool of liquid with four raised granular-looking colored mounds: gray at upper left, red at upper center, blue at center-left, and yellow at right. Blue color occupies much of the left side of the liquid, orange-red color occupies the upper/right side, and yellow-green color occupies the lower/right side. Over the clip, the colored areas around the mounds remain in the same general locations while their edges become softer and slightly more spread out. The mounds stay visible and keep their raised textured forms, with small bright speckles or bubble-like spots on their surfaces. No tools or hands enter the scene.

reasons: The bowl, liquid surface, colored regions, and four raised mounds are already visible in the first frame.
The visible color-spreading process appears already underway at the start.
